overall_assessment: All 10 packet entries were reviewed in full, including all displayed removed spans; HIS1400L is capped by the packet builder. Both name_like flags are false positives from course titles and organisation/publication names, and no personal-data leaks were found in suspects or controls. Email and dated-semester removal generally works without content loss, but two random controls expose damaged cohort-dependent examination text and unremoved submission dates; historical years, season-only teaching information and institutional contact names are correctly retained.

findings.evidence: Muntlig eksamen er obligatorisk for deg som fikk opptak fra og med. Muntlig eksamen er valgfritt for deg som fikk opptak til masterspesialiseringen eller tidligere.
findings.description: Removing the admission semesters leaves incomplete temporal conditions and makes the obligatory versus optional oral-examination distinction impossible to interpret. These are damaged substantive examination rules, not harmless dangling administrative labels. The removed spans show that the missing conditions were høsten 2021 and høsten 2020; neither suspect flag detects this defect.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R:.anon_generic() removes season-plus-year tokens in running prose without handling the surrounding cohort-dependent condition. Its .course_start guard does not cover admission cohorts, and .condition_year/.or_later protect academic-year ranges rather than these semester expressions.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a deterministic .anon_uio() rule before generic date removal that handles these two cohort-qualified examination sentences together, replacing them with a grammatical date-free statement that the oral-examination requirement depends on admission cohort. Add a regression case ensuring that fra og med and eller tidligere are never left without their temporal operands.

findings.description: Administrative thesis-submission dates remain in the course facts box. These are submission deadlines, not government-document dates or subject-matter dates, and therefore fall under the rubric requirement to remove administrative dates. The pre-pass did not flag these written-month dates without a year.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R:.anon_uio() has no submission-deadline rule. Generic date removal primarily handles numeric dates, dated semesters and approval/update contexts; .long_dates_regex requires a final year and is used for approval dates.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_uio(), strip day-and-written-month date lists following the anchored Innleveringsfrister label, including lists joined by og and dates without years, while preserving unrelated content dates. Add this exact two-deadline line as a regression case.
